brain-page.use: Project Brain persistent memory: load context at task start, record durable decisions.

brain-setup.use: One-time Brain scaffolding for a new project.

brain-bootstrap.use: Bootstrap Brain pages from existing project material.

brain-ingest.use: Ingest external documents into Brain pages.

ui-ux-pro-max.use: UI/UX design intelligence: use when designing, building, reviewing, or fixing anything visual or interactive. Skip for pure backend, API, database, or infra work.

coUse.ui-work: For UI tasks, load brain context first (brain-page), then apply skills/ui-ux-pro-max/SKILL.md: record the chosen design system back to the Brain.
